title: A Fourier coefficient bounding a convolution average
statement: Let $u:\mathbb F_2^d\to\mathbb R$ and let $v:\mathbb F_2^d\to\{-1,1\}$. There is a vector $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^d$ such that the uniform average of $u(x)$ times the normalized additive convolution of $v$ with itself at $x$ is at most the vector Fourier coefficient of $u$ indexed by $\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^d$
$v$ is a sign-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^d$
